t.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `half`, `bfloat16`, `float32`, `float64`. Typically 2-D, but may have any dimensions.
constraints: t must be a Tensor with type in ['half', 'bfloat16', 'float32', 'float64'] and can have any number of dimensions.
t must be one of half, bfloat16, float32, float64
The output is calculated by summing squares of elements in t and dividing by 2.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `t`.
